invariants.rationale: Method parameter context should not be null at method entry.

meta.value: The context parameter is expected to be non-null for method execution.

invariants.rationale: Method parameter instantTime should not be null.

meta.value: The instantTime parameter should be non-null to schedule compaction properly.

invariants.rationale: Option object extraMetadata must be non-null.

meta.value: The extraMetadata option object itself should not be null even if it is empty or None.
